examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Button Display Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates two methods to create buttons, either with child components or using text content.

examples.title: Example 2: Adding Render Control to a Button
examples.description: This example uses if/else statements to control the display text of the button.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Button Text Style
examples.description: This example customizes the display style of button text by configuring labelStyle.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting Importance of Different Sized Buttons
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the importance of buttons of different sizes by configuring controlSize and buttonStyle.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Button Role
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the role of the button by configuring role.

examples.title: Example 6: Implementing a Custom Button
examples.description: This example implements a custom button in the shape of a circle. The circle is red when pressed, accompanied by the text "Pressed" in the title. It is black when not pressed, accompanied by the text "Not pressed" in the title.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting Rounded Rectangle Buttons
examples.description: This example creates rounded rectangle buttons by configuring ButtonType.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE.

examples.title: Example 8 (Setting the Horizontal Alignment Mode of the Label Text)
examples.description:
This example shows how to set the text alignment mode by configuring textAlign of LabelStyle.
The textAlign API is supported since API version 23.
